name: An overdue self-set deadline drops beneath live deadlines and carries a move-the-date proposal
why: Engine direction review 2026-08-18: five live projects sat at the top of the ladder forever because their self-set dates had passed. A passed date cannot be recovered by working now, so it is a stale date: it ranks as ordinary work, below every live deadline, and the forecast proposes the earliest date the remaining work would fit without displacing anything.
